## Earlier activities

In **April 2024**, I presented work on multivariate methods for understanding agricultural practices in cacao cultivation in the northern Ecuadorian Amazon, at ESPOL's Showcase of Statistical Business Practice Projects in Guayaquil.

In **October 2023**, I helped organize the **20th Statistics Conference** at ESPOL.
